conditions: Each piece only drops from its own pool; check Konzu's reward list before committing, and if the piece isn't listed, nothing this cycle can drop it.
Stages 1-3 never pay Furax Wraith pieces, so aborting early wastes the run.
The pool letter is global and time-based; a cycle can end mid-bounty and the next bounty uses the new pool.
bonuses: Rerunning the same bounty in one cycle still pays item rewards, just no standing.
Steel Path Cetus bounties have the same rates.

disclosures.title: the odds and pace
disclosures.body: A full 40-60 bounty in the right pool is roughly a 13% shot at that piece, about 7-8 full bounties per piece. Runs take about 6-7 minutes with a competent build; squad up, and reroll by returning to Cetus if the objective chain is slow (defense, spy, long escort).

disclosures.title: Dog Days
disclosures.body: The annual summer event (normally August into early September) has Nakak sell each piece for 120 Pearls, 360 total, no RNG. The first three event missions pay 10/20/30 once; the repeatable top mission pays 30 plus 2 per personal kill and 1 per assist. Lob Blob water balloons one-shot on a direct hit; public squads give more kills than solo, which spawns only three enemies.

disclosures.title: Incarnon Genesis
disclosures.body: The Furax Incarnon Genesis also fits Furax Wraith: a Steel Path Circuit reward on a rotating schedule, then 20 Pathos Clamps, 70 Dracroot and 300 Ariette Scales to install.
